brief.subject: A sculptural desk lamp with a curved ceramic shade, a brass stem and a weighted base
brief.purpose: Give the product page a calm material backdrop while the real 3D lamp remains interactive
brief.materials: Matte fired ceramic, brushed brass and frosted glass with stable proportions
brief.lighting: One broad softbox from the left and a slow warm light pass; no camera or object motion
brief.palette: Warm ivory, muted clay and aged brass; no neon accent
